bio: A stone's throw from Place Stanislas, this restaurant allies rustic charm with contemporary touches. A bright dining area with bay windows overlooks the kitchen, where the team can be seen creating refined bistronomy dishes. The menu features generous, cleverly devised dishes, such as tomato stuffed with burrata and pesto, a duo of courgettes and slow-cooked pollock, and dark chocolate and passion fruit truffles. The modern and seasonal cuisine adheres to a commitment to bold flavours and well-prepared ingredients in a pleasant and lively setting – it is also good value for money....
